name: What is involved in a primary bathroom remodel with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in a primary bathroom remodel with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: A primary bathroom remodel with AKN Design Group transforms your existing space into a functional, spa-inspired retreat. This involves a comprehensive design-build process where we rework the bathroom around comfort, function, and refined finishes. Our solutions can include a larger walk-in shower with a frameless glass enclosure, custom vanity solutions, upgraded tile work, improved layered lighting, and storage tailored to your specific routines and aesthetic preferences. Our integrated approach ensures a single point of coordination from initial concept development and CAD-supported layouts through construction, installation, and final walkthrough.
acceptedAnswer.description: A primary bathroom remodel with AKN Design Group involves a comprehensive design-build process to transform your space into a functional, spa-inspired retreat, coordinating all aspects from design to installation.
